# The seeded data for this suite — and the four things seeding it proved

**Seeded:** 2026-09-29 · **Environment:** `app.staging.shopview.com`, workplace
**Staging Heavy Duty - 9919** · **Build at seed time:** `v26.39.1-1efc285`, redeployed mid-session
to `v26.39.1-97cad2c` (see §5)
**Manifest:** `build/global-search/seeding/seed-manifest-result-integrity.json` — generated by
`build_result_integrity_manifest.py`, never hand-edited
**Result:** **34 / 34 records present, 0 field gaps**, re-verified after the redeploy

---

## 1 · Why the data had to be built rather than found

Before this, 33 of the 110 tests told the tester to go and find the data. That is not a runnable
test: the tester has to hunt, and most will pick a value that also appears in the record's name —
which makes the test prove nothing, because the row then had another reason to appear.

**After seeding, 105 of the 110 rows carry a search term that was checked against the live system**
and kept only when the response confirmed the match came from the field the test is about.

---

## 2 · The shape everything is built on

Two records per entity carrying a **long name whose only difference is the trailing six digits**:

```
ZZLONGROW Heavy Haulage And Trailer Repair Services Of Greater Fernvale 123786
ZZLONGROW Heavy Haulage And Trailer Repair Services Of Greater Fernvale 185786
```

This is the QA lead's own statement of the defect, built as data. **If the row truncates, the two
are indistinguishable and the test proves itself.** One shape serves A1, A2, A3, B1, B2 and G2 on
every tab.

Alongside it: a vendor whose distinctive values sit only in fields the row never shows (its email,
its address line 2); a customer whose province is distinctive and whose name is not; a vehicle whose
only distinctive value is its VIN; a vehicle with no unit number at all; and a near-miss name pair
(`ZZSOFTHIT` / `ZZSOFTHIY`) that gives all nine tabs a provable soft match.

---

## 3 · Four things the seeding proved — none of which a test could have assumed

### 3.1 The product forbids two customers with the same name

`/api/customers/create` → **400 `{"error":"Company with provided name already exists."}`**

So "two rows with an identical bold line" **cannot happen on the Customers tab**. `SRI-CUST-B2` is
now marked **not applicable** with that reason, rather than sitting there asking a tester to find
data that cannot be made. **Vendors have no such rule** — the two identically-named vendors were
both created, 201 each.

### 3.2 A purchase order is findable by a number that is not on it

The row displays **`I2-1522`**. Typing **`I-1522`** finds it, matching on `number_variants`:

```
I-1522   -> 'I2-1522'   field=number_variants  kind=exact
I2-1522  -> 'I2-1522'   field=number           kind=exact
```

The form that matched appears **nowhere on the row**. This is Q1's problem in its purest form, and
`number_variants` is not in PRD §4 at all (question Q7).

### 3.3 The soft-match affordance reaches all nine tabs

`ZZSOFTHIT` returns a `kind=fuzzy` row in work orders, part sales, purchase orders, vendor invoices,
customers and vendors — matched on `customer_name` or `vendor_name`. Before this, the four
identifier-led tabs had no proven fuzzy case at all and their Class I rows were blank.

### 3.4 A part sale cannot be told from its sibling by customer name

Two part sales for one customer are indistinguishable to any finder keyed on the customer — the
second reported itself present having found the first, **and was never created**. The list row also
carries `unit`, which differs per vehicle; keying on that produced a real pair. *This is the same
class of mistake the suite tests for, made in its own fixtures* — see §4.

---

## 4 · Three mistakes made building this, kept here because they are the lesson

**A finder keyed on a field that is not unique silently creates nothing.** Both halves of the
identical-name pairs searched on `name`, so the second found the first, reported itself present, and
was never created — leaving one record where the test needs two, with the second's address written
over the first's. Same for the part sales on `companyName`. **The record count said 35/35 and was
wrong.** Fixed by keying each finder on something that actually differs.

**Three contacts shared one email address.** The verifier answered a query for the twin's contact
with a different company entirely — three records, one value, no way to attribute a hit to any of
them. The manifest now gives each its own address. 🔴 **The three live records still hold the old
shared address**: `/api/contacts/change` rejects every payload shape tried (400), so they will only
correct on a fresh reseed into a clean estate. The seeder reports this as a field gap on every run,
so it stays visible. No test in the workbook depends on those three addresses.

**A vendor cannot borrow its own tax id.** The first manifest resolved `tax_id` by matching the
vendor's own name — the record being created — so it resolved to nothing and all seven vendors died
on `400 {"tax_id":"Missing required parameter"}`.

---

## 5 · Staging was redeployed while this ran — and it nearly cost two findings

The build moved from `v26.39.1-1efc285` to `v26.39.1-97cad2c` mid-session. Immediately after, a
discovery pass reported **0 rows** for two probes that had returned 9 and 5 minutes earlier. Checking
the build marker first — rather than believing the zero — showed the data was untouched: the same
queries returned 9 and 5 again on a re-check.

**A zero right after a redeploy is a question, not an answer.** The seeded universe was re-verified
after the redeploy and reads 34 / 34.

---

## 6 · What is still not seeded, and why

| Test | Why |
|---|---|
| `SRI-CUST-B2` | **Not applicable** — the product forbids it (§3.1) |
| `SRI-WO-C2`, `SRI-WO-C3` | Need a work order assigned to a distinctively-named technician and service advisor. Creating staff was not attempted |
| `SRI-VEND-C4`, `SRI-VEND-C5` | Need a contact on a vendor. Three endpoints tried, all 404 or 400 — no route found for adding one |

These five rows say plainly what to look for, rather than carrying a guessed term.

---

## 7 · Rebuilding it

```
cd build/global-search/seeding
SEED_PROFILE=/tmp/staging/cookies.json SEED_WORKPLACE="Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" \
  SEED_MANIFEST=seed-manifest-result-integrity.json python3 seed.py --check      # measure first
  …same, with --confirm                                                          # then create
  …same, with verify_by_search.py                                                # then PROVE by search
```

The seeder measures before it creates and is safe to re-run. **A run is finished when the search
returns the records, never when the seeder prints 34/34** — "the record exists" is not "the search
returns it".

🔴 **The work-order and purchase-order numbers in the workbook are branch-assigned** and change on a
reseed or redeploy (Rule 111). Re-read them from `seed-state-live-resultintegrity-staging.json`
before a test run rather than trusting the cell.
